title: 🔆🔅The head of Qeshm Island's Department of Environment has reported an oil slick detected on the southern coasts of the island and the Suza shoreline. Environmental protection teams were immediately dispatched to the site for field assessments.
text:
🔆🔅The head of Qeshm Island's Department of Environment has reported an oil slick detected on the southern coasts of the island and the Suza shoreline. Environmental protection teams were immediately dispatched to the site for field assessments."

"Shahmorad Jafari stated that approximately one kilometer of the Suza coast has been impacted by the pollution. He noted that due to tidal conditions, no contamination was observed in the surrounding marine waters at the time. Water and sediment samples have been collected from the beach and sent to the pollution monitoring center for detailed analysis."

"According to Jafari, today's assessments indicate that the oil pollution has now spread to the Shib Deraz area."

"He confirmed that investigations are still underway to determine the source of the oil slick. The Ports and Maritime Organization is the designated agency responsible for the cleanup effort. Following an order from the local prosecutor, the Ports Department and the municipality are currently engaged in cleaning the affected coastline."

"Jafari added that no aquatic fatalities or damage to local infrastructure have been reported as a result of the spill so far.
